summary: Specifies IPv4 compatibility mechanisms that IPv6 hosts and routers can implement, helping the two protocols coexist during the move to IPv6. It was replaced by RFC 2893.

eli5.summary: A bridge between old and new roads, so cars can keep driving while the new road is built. This describes ways for the old and new Internet to share space.
